message.content: {"note_claim": "In December 2025 the US extended the Sahalin-2 transaction permit to June 18, 2026, and the take-or-pay clause means Japan must pay Russia even if it doesn't take LNG, so it is not a sanction.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "19日までだったサハリン2との取引許可が、2026年6月18日まで延長される。", "reason": "The Nikkei article directly states the permit extension to June 18, 2026 and quotes the take-or-pay explanation that the note repeats nearly verbatim."}

parsed.note_claim: In December 2025 the US extended the Sahalin-2 transaction permit to June 18, 2026, and the take-or-pay clause means Japan must pay Russia even if it doesn't take LNG, so it is not a sanction.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: 19日までだったサハリン2との取引許可が、2026年6月18日まで延長される。
parsed.reason: The Nikkei article directly states the permit extension to June 18, 2026 and quotes the take-or-pay explanation that the note repeats nearly verbatim.
